Goyal links 'Made in India' to national duty and pride

Union Minister Piyush Goyal has stated that the 'Made in India' label signifies a national duty. He emphasized that this initiative is linked to national pride and aims to promote domestic manufacturing. The initiative is presented as a call to action for citizens and industries.
